Thanks for the idea. Requests help decide what to build next, so do not be shy.

**Which resource label do you want?**
For example: Copper, Stone, Gold, animal hides, and so on. Naming the specific resource is the most helpful thing you can do here.


**Why would this help you?**
A sentence about how you would use it (for example, "so I can tell my Copper chest from my Iron chest").


**Any art notes? (optional)**
If you have a picture in mind for the icon, describe it. (New icons follow the game's wooden-plaque style; see CONTRIBUTING.md if you are curious.)


**Anything else?**
